GRID welcomes researchers, educators, and data contributors interested in river chemistry and watershed science.

## Contribute a dataset

Start with a short description of the observations, location and time coverage, available metadata, and ownership or reuse conditions. Include a repository link if the data are already public. For unpublished data, discuss permissions and release timing before transferring files.

[Read the contribution guidance](database/contribute-data.qmd)

## Propose research

Describe the scientific question, the relevant GRID release or data needs, and the contribution you would like to make. Links to related work or analysis code help the team assess a possible collaboration.

[Meet the team](people/people.qmd) · [Read the development roadmap](development.qmd)

## Teach with GRID resources

Explore activities on water quality and environmental data science. Tell us which resource you used, your teaching context, and any difficulties or improvements you would like to share.

[Explore teaching resources](education/index.qmd)

## Contact

Email [Tao Wen](mailto:twen08@syr.edu) with a subject identifying your interest: data contribution, research collaboration, or teaching. Please send a brief inquiry first so that any data transfer can follow the appropriate permissions and arrangements.
